connector.name: Opc MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: OPC Suite - CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HRM, payroll, claims, projects from any AI agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at myopc.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package opc-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the steveser1989 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPC_API_TOKEN
env.description: Personal API Token generated at /dashboard/settings/developer (starts with opc_pat_).

env.name: OPC_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your OPC workspace. Defaults to https://www.myopc.io.

env.name: OPC_AGENT_KIND
env.description: Agent identifier used for audit logs (claude, codex, cursor, hermes, etc.).
